_about: Crawler registry used by audit.py, bot_access.py and log_bots.py. purpose: search = builds an index that answers cite; user = fetches live because a person asked; training = model-training corpus; control = robots token only, never sends requests; agent = browser agent acting for a user. tier 'core' decides AI-search visibility and is checked everywhere; 'extra' is reported in logs. fallback = token whose robots group applies when this bot is not named (before '*'). robots: yes | partial | no (documented behaviour). Source: references/technical-access.md (dossier fetched 2026-09-26). Re-verify rows against owner docs every quarter.

bots.note: Feeds Search AND AI Overviews / AI Mode. Blocking it removes you from both. The only AI-feature controls are nosnippet, data-nosnippet, max-snippet, noindex (and the 2026 Search Console AI-features toggle).
Token only. Gemini training + grounding in Gemini apps / Vertex. Does NOT affect AI Overviews or AI Mode, and is not a ranking signal.
